'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Brandon Burgt LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Burgt]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
